title: Rav Chama bar Guria
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman describes him as Rav’s great student, noting that we always find “Rav Chama bar Guria said that Rav said,” as in Shabbat 9a, 10b, 11b, 37a and 139b; Eruvin 9a, 46b, 47a and 60a; Megillah 18b and 19a; Taanit 12b and 27a; Moed Katan 12a; Yevamot 45b; Gittin 86b; Kiddushin 76b; Bava Kamma 113b; Avodah Zarah 16b; Menachot 32b and 78a; Chullin 45a; and Shabbat 9:11 [Jerusalem Talmud]. In Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 4:15: a man came before Rav and told him that he was born of a gentile; he said, “Fit.” Rav Chama bar Guria said to him: “Wherever your feet will carry you (go quickly from here), before Shmuel comes and disqualifies you.”
Afterward he studied before Shmuel, as in Bava Kamma 99b, where he raised an objection to Shmuel, and Shmuel said to him, “May your brain be muddled!”

Hyman states that all the great men of the generation received from him, as we find “Avin bar Huna said that Rav Chama bar Guria said,” as in Shabbat 66b (the Alfasi reads “Rav Huna said that Rav Chama bar Guria said”) and Zevachim 62b;

Rabbi Chelbo said that Rav Chama bar Guria said, as in Shabbat 37a, Megillah 18b and Chullin 45a; in Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 2:4, “Rabbi Chelbo, Rav Chama bar Guria in the name of Rav Chama bar Ukva in the name of Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Chanina,” Hyman proposes “Rabbi Chelbo in the name of Rav Chama bar Guria; Rav Chama bar Ukva in the name of Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Chanina”;
Rav Chisda said that Rav Chama bar Guria said: Menachot 78a;

Rav Minyomi bar Chilkiyah said that Rav Chama bar Guria said: Menachot 32b. Rabbah son of Rav Huna called him “our Rabbis who are expert in the matter of halakhah” (according to one version), as in Gittin 86b. Rabbah bar Mechasya said that Rav Chama bar Guria said: Taanit 12a.
He is likewise mentioned in Shabbat 82b and Pesachim 86a.

notes.text: Saved Davidson BK99b explicitly RavChama barGuria and the imprecation לעכר מוחך, may your brain be muddled, supports finite Rav expansions and the correction of to muddle your mind. Preserve Hyman’s full Rav heading. The final Taanit יב. is 12a; the earlier list’s יב: is 12b. Preserve both different source locators.

The consulted Bava Kamma 99b directly names Rav Chama bar Guria and preserves Shmuel’s imprecation. Hyman’s always-title and leading-generation claims remain attributed, as do the Alfasi reading and Jerusalem Talmud Megillah chain repartition. The earlier Taanit 12b and final 12a remain distinct supplied locators; neither is silently normalized from the other.
